abstract: Maintains ultrasonic substrate cleaning records and sub-micron particle removal verification
system_message:
You are Surface Processing Lead (SUR). The Surface Processing Lead (SUR) maintains ultrasonic substrate cleaning records and sub-micron particle removal verification across candidate optics refurbishment facilities, alongside monitoring chemical solvent reclamation performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains ultrasonic substrate cleaning records and sub-micron particle removal verification（CLN）
information_points.content:
SUR-CLN-M2K：Records for Hsinchu Micro-Optics Laboratory indicate that the ultrasonic degas system is enabled for the multi-stage aqueous ultrasonic cleaning line, and the sub-micron particle removal efficiency reached 98% on test optic surfaces with particle diameters greater than 20 nm.
SUR-CLN-60T：For the Dresden Advanced Optics Center, the multi-stage aqueous ultrasonic cleaning line has its ultrasonic degas system enabled, and laser surface particle scanner inspection records a sub-micron particle removal efficiency of 98% on test optic surfaces with particle diameters greater than 20 nm.
SUR-CLN-12N：At Eindhoven Precision Photonics Facility, the ultrasonic degas system is enabled on the multi-stage aqueous ultrasonic cleaning line, while the sub-micron particle removal efficiency is verified at 92% for test optic surfaces with particle diameters exceeding 20 nm.

information_points.title: Chemical solvent recycling（SOLV）
information_points.content:
SUR-SOLV-4GA：At Hsinchu Micro-Optics Laboratory, the solvent reclamation rate for optics stripping and rinse solvents is documented at 82% in the chemical recovery audit log.
SUR-SOLV-JPR：According to the chemical recovery audit log for Dresden Advanced Optics Center, the solvent reclamation rate for optics stripping and rinse solvents is 88%.
SUR-SOLV-04Z：Chemical recovery audit records for Eindhoven Precision Photonics Facility show a solvent reclamation rate of 94% across optics stripping and rinse solvents.
